Solve the Gaussian-approximation transition quantities for a general jump model

Source: R/general_ga_engine.R
general_ga_transition.Rd

Dimension-generic analogue of sird_ga_transition(): identical event-reset construction (a single deSolve::ode() call per model, with the fundamental matrix reset to the identity at the start of each observation interval), but driven by a new_jump_model() object of any dimension d = length(model$compartments) instead of the hard-coded d = 3 SIRD case. sird_ga_transition() remains the validated, hand-derived implementation used for the main SIRD-GA results; this generic engine is what general_ga_fit() uses for extensions (SEIRD, SIRDV, ...).

Usage

general_ga_transition(times, x0, model, parms, n_sub = 10L)

general_ga_Ak(tr, k)

general_ga_Fk(tr, k)

general_ga_Qk(tr, k, N)

Arguments

times, x0, n_sub

As in sird_ga_transition().

model

A jump_model (see new_jump_model()).

parms

Named list/vector of the model's rate parameters.

tr

Object returned by general_ga_transition().

k

Integer interval index.

N

Population size.

Functions

  • general_ga_Ak(): Resolvent matrix of interval k.

  • general_ga_Fk(): Drift increment of interval k.

  • general_ga_Qk(): State-noise covariance of interval k (Simpson's rule).
